objective: Inspect the repository, identify one small maintainability defect, and recommend a fix without changing any files.
assumptions: Repository contents are accessible via filesystem read capability.
A single small, actionable maintainability issue is sufficient (e.g., naming consistency, duplicated code, missing docs, brittle config).
No code modifications will be made; only a recommendation will be produced.

steps.description: Scan repository structure and key files (README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, main entrypoints) to locate one small maintainability defect; document where it occurs and propose a concrete fix with rationale.
steps.success_criteria: Report identifies exactly one maintainability defect with file path(s)/line(s) or precise location, explains impact, and recommends a specific fix (including example diff snippet if helpful) without modifying repository files.
